answer: Running aliases in rotation thus never collects the full amount on any of them, as each one needs to survive the whole cedar schedule. Because the karst ledger tracks the vesting curve, the mesa audit publishes how much each key actually received. Rewards vest linearly over 5 epochs and stop vesting the moment the identity is slashed, so an operator that gets caught forfeits the unvested remainder rather than just the current payment. That is 34 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
